posts.name: mightyschoop
posts.cooked:
Confirmed - Wagner Mars Base, Break the cocoon and Mind Spike flipped Gloomweaver for the kill.

Visionary was at 23 hp, so low hp is definitely not necessary. One hero was below 10 hp. 

One cultist was in play, but Visionary didn't ko it.

Visionary's only other card in play was a Twist the Ether on Gloomy.

I used Wraith, Haka, Legacy, Visionary (in that order)

Wraith to search Gloomy's deck for Relics (and deliver beatdowns), Haka to clean up cultists and zombies, Legacy to pull out the LffF/Next Evo combo and keep everyone safe from the damage Gloomy throws around while the relics are in play. Visionary helped Legacy draw cards until the right stuff came out, used Precognition to help search the deck, and went into the cocoon once Gloomy flipped.

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
Here is my very slowly but guaranteed method of working:

Play with Visionary, Fanatic, and Absolute Zero against Gloomy, I was in Insula Primas but that doesn't.

Reroll until Visionary starts with Cocoon.....that's it.

Keep skipping turns, and let Fanatic and Absolute Zero die, you don't have to destroy or play anything.

Both Fanatic and Absolute Zero have incapped abilities that increase the next damage by 2.

Keep skipping turns until Gloomy flips, and Visionary can come out of the cocoon and destroy Gloomy in one hit.
